title.en: AI-Assisted Product Descriptions and Seller-Contact Intentions in C2C Second-Hand Marketplaces: Product-Information Authenticity, Provenance Transparency, and Seller Reputation
title.zh: AI辅助二手商品文案如何影响C2C买家联系卖家意向：商品信息真实性、来源透明度与卖家声誉

researchQuestions.text: How do truthfully disclosed listing-production modes (seller-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated) affect buyers' seller-contact and purchase intentions in C2C second-hand marketplaces?
To what extent does perceived product-information authenticity explain the effect of listing-production mode on seller-contact intention?

How does accountable AI-provenance transparency interact with seller reputation to affect perceived product-information authenticity and seller-contact intention when listing content is held constant?
Do information diagnosticity and seller trust provide credible rival explanations beyond the focal product-information-authenticity mechanism?

constructs.definition: Intention to contact the seller, ask for details, or view contact options in the presented scenario.
Intention to consider or attempt to purchase the displayed item.
The extent to which the description is perceived to truthfully correspond to the item's actual condition and reflect the seller's first-hand knowledge.
Willingness to rely on the seller under uncertainty based on perceived honesty and dependability.
The extent to which the description helps the buyer judge item condition, fit, and transaction value.
The participant's ability to understand AI capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.

experiments.name: Truthfully disclosed production-mode experiment
experiments.stimulusSource: consenting experienced C2C sellers contribute de-identified facts and photos for owned used smartphones and audit all source labels

experiments.name: Accountable provenance transparency by seller reputation experiment
experiments.stimulusSource: the verified AI-assisted versions from the separately consented stimulus-contributor set

hypotheses.text: AI-generated descriptions reduce product-information authenticity relative to seller-written descriptions.
AI-generated descriptions reduce product-information authenticity relative to AI-assisted descriptions.
Product-information authenticity is positively associated with seller-contact intention.
Product-information authenticity statistically mediates the AI-generated versus seller-written contrast on seller-contact intention.
Product-information authenticity statistically mediates the AI-generated versus AI-assisted contrast on seller-contact intention.
Accountable provenance transparency increases product-information authenticity relative to a basic AI-assisted label.
Established high reputation increases seller-contact intention relative to no reputation history.
The effect of accountable transparency on authenticity is stronger for a new seller than for an established seller.
The indirect effect of accountable transparency on contact intention through authenticity is stronger for a new seller.
